response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_of_media_averages FROM media_averages) SELECT ma.media_type_name, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond, ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_of_media_averages AS amount_above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS ma CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ma.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.average_of_media_averages
